title: Expert Recommender Short Response
description: Schema for the /expert/recommender response when short_response=true.

Response.description: The expert recommender payload in short-response format.

SuccessResponse.description: Short-form recommender response containing compact topic, work, institution, author, and metadata arrays.

topics.description: Topics identified as relevant to the query.

works.description: Relevant works associated with the recommended experts.

institutions.description: Institutions associated with the recommended experts.

authors.description: Recommended experts in shortened author form.

meta.description: Aggregate counts and search metadata for the recommender response.

Topic.description: A short representation of a relevant OpenAlex topic.

Work.description: A short representation of a work related to the recommended experts.

doi.description: DOI URL for the work, if available.

primary_topic.description: OpenAlex topic identifier of the work's primary topic.

author_ids.description: OpenAlex author identifiers for authors of the work.

Institution.description: A short representation of an institution connected to the recommended experts.

ror.description: ROR identifier URL for the institution, if available.

country_code.description: Two-letter country code of the institution, if available.

type.description: Institution type as returned by OpenAlex, if available.

AuthorInstitution.description: A time-bounded affiliation between an author and an institution.

Author.description: A short representation of a recommended expert.

orcid_id.description: ORCID identifier URL for the author, if available.

two_yr_mean_citedness.description: Average citedness metric over two years, if available.

relevant_topics.description: OpenAlex topic identifiers marked as relevant for this author.

relevant_topics_share.description: Count of relevant topics associated with the author.

active_years_min.description: Earliest active publication year detected for the author.

active_years_max.description: Latest active publication year detected for the author.

active_years_sum.description: Number of active publication years counted for the author.

institutions.description: List of author affiliations with start and end years, or null if unavailable.

instituitions_count.description: Number of institution affiliations in the institutions list.

works.description: List of OpenAlex work identifiers associated with the author, or null if unavailable.

works_count.description: Number of works in the works list.

Meta.description: Aggregate metadata for the recommender output and the underlying expert search.

author_count.description: Total number of authors returned in the recommender response.

works_count.description: Total number of works returned in the recommender response.

institutions_count.description: Total number of institutions returned in the recommender response.

author_min_score.description: Lowest overall author score among returned authors.

author_max_score.description: Highest overall author score among returned authors.

search.description: Metadata from the underlying expert search stage, or null if unavailable.

SearchMeta.description: Metadata describing the underlying expert search request and its aggregated results.

query.description: Original query string sent to expert search.

generated_queries.description: Alternative generated queries used for the search, if query expansion was enabled.

reference_author_count.description: Number of reference authors identified during the search stage.

author_count.description: Total number of authors found during the search stage.

works_count.description: Total number of works found during the search stage.

institutions_count.description: Total number of institutions found during the search stage.

best_match_topics.description: Map of topic short IDs to counts of how often they matched in the search results.

topics_filter.description: OpenAlex topic filter expression used when retrieving additional works.

authors_topic_share_counts.description: Map of relevant-topic-share values to the number of authors having each value.
